orchestration.name: ready-for-agent
orchestration.description: Orchestrator may pick this issue up for autonomous processing

orchestration.name: complexity:low
orchestration.description: Route to Haiku — simple, well-scoped task

orchestration.name: complexity:medium
orchestration.description: Route to Sonnet — moderate complexity task

orchestration.name: complexity:high
orchestration.description: Route to Opus — complex task requiring deep reasoning

orchestration.name: gate:mechanical
orchestration.description: Mechanical path — main agent edits; no specialist chains (ADR 0012)

orchestration.name: type:afk
orchestration.description: Agent can implement and merge without human interaction

orchestration.name: type:hitl
orchestration.description: Human decision required before an agent can proceed — skipped by dispatch-agents

orchestration.name: status:in-progress
orchestration.description: Agent has picked up the issue and is working on it

orchestration.name: status:blocked
orchestration.description: Waiting on blocker issue(s) in ## Blocked by — skipped by dispatch-agents until unblocked

orchestration.name: status:done
orchestration.description: Agent finished; slice integrated into the local feature branch

orchestration.name: prd
orchestration.description: Product Requirements Document — parent issue for a planned feature

orchestration.name: qa
orchestration.description: A QA Plan Issue — manual verification for work whose PR is open (ADR 0048)

orchestration.name: grilling
orchestration.description: Design must be stress-tested in a grilling session before work starts — dispatch-agents skips it
